verdict.rationale: Cal.com lists payments as a core capability, offers a PayPal app to "charge for your bookings," and exposes BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED and BOOKING_PAID webhook triggers, which tie payment to the booking lifecycle. A community comment complaining about being "forced to use Stripe" indirectly corroborates that Stripe payment at booking exists; it requests bring-your-own-payment flows rather than contradicting the capability. Missing for 10: first-party docs detailing the Stripe setup and per-event-type pricing configuration, and explicit documentation that payment is captured at booking time.
